metadata.title: Standardize orjson usage across gateway, plugins, and MCP servers
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
Closes #2030 

## Summary

- Standardized JSON serialization/deserialization on orjson across gateway endpoints, services, plugins, MCP servers, and templates.
- Added consistent JSON parsing/error handling for request bodies; JSON-RPC now returns a proper parse error for invalid JSON.
- Cleaned up orjson exception handling mismatches and removed dead json imports/invalid helper calls.

## Key Changes

- Gateway: request parsing moved to a shared helper for 400 on invalid JSON; admin request parsing uses orjson; JSON-RPC parse errors handled explicitly.
- Plugins: aligned JSON decode error handling to `orjson.JSONDecodeError`.
- MCP servers/templates: replaced stdlib json usage with orjson helpers and updated dependencies.
